HOME EMERGENCY INFORMATION SHEET

A useful home emergency sheet keeps essential property information in one offline place: address details, utility suppliers, meter locations, water isolation, consumer unit, heating controls, insurers and trusted trades or managing-agent contacts.

FREE / NEXT STEP

HOME SYSTEMS CHECK

Check whether the important shut-offs, controls, meters and contacts in this property are actually known and recorded.

RUN THE FREE CHECK

WHAT TO DO WITH THIS

Keep it concise enough to use under stress and review it whenever you move supplier, change heating equipment or alter the property.

LIMITS / SAFETY

Do not include passwords, alarm codes, full payment details or anything that would create a security risk if the sheet were seen by someone else.
